sql: REVOKE ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA dw, mart FROM marketing_analyst
REVOKE USAGE ON SCHEMA dw, mart FROM marketing_analyst
GRANT CONNECT ON DATABASE bank_dw TO marketing_analyst
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS governed_marketing_analyst
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA governed_marketing_analyst TO marketing_analyst
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS governed_marketing_analyst.dim_account
CREATE VIEW governed_marketing_analyst.dim_account AS SELECT account_key, account_id, customer_key, account_type, account_status, opened_on FROM dw.dim_account
GRANT SELECT ON governed_marketing_analyst.dim_account TO marketing_analyst
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS governed_marketing_analyst.dim_branch
CREATE VIEW governed_marketing_analyst.dim_branch AS SELECT branch_key, transit_number, branch_name, city, province FROM dw.dim_branch
GRANT SELECT ON governed_marketing_analyst.dim_branch TO marketing_analyst
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS governed_marketing_analyst.dim_consent

CREATE VIEW governed_marketing_analyst.dim_consent AS SELECT customer_key, purpose, granted, consent_type, captured_on, withdrawn_on FROM dw.dim_consent WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dw.dim_consent dc WHERE dc.customer_key = dw.dim_consent.customer_key AND dc.purpose = 'MARKETING_EMAIL' AND dc.granted AND dc.withdrawn_on IS NULL)
GRANT SELECT ON governed_marketing_analyst.dim_consent TO marketing_analyst
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS governed_marketing_analyst.dim_customer

CREATE VIEW governed_marketing_analyst.dim_customer AS SELECT customer_key, customer_id, md5(full_name::text) AS full_name, md5(email::text) AS email, birth_year, age_band, province, postal_fsa, income_band, customer_status, customer_since, closed_on FROM dw.dim_customer
GRANT SELECT ON governed_marketing_analyst.dim_customer TO marketing_analyst
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS governed_marketing_analyst.dim_date
CREATE VIEW governed_marketing_analyst.dim_date AS SELECT date_key, full_date, year, quarter, month, day_of_week FROM dw.dim_date
GRANT SELECT ON governed_marketing_analyst.dim_date TO marketing_analyst
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS governed_marketing_analyst.fact_transaction

CREATE VIEW governed_marketing_analyst.fact_transaction AS SELECT transaction_key, date_key, account_key, customer_key, branch_key, amount_cad, txn_type, channel, merchant_category FROM dw.fact_transaction
GRANT SELECT ON governed_marketing_analyst.fact_transaction TO marketing_analyst
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS governed_marketing_analyst.aml_large_cash_txn

CREATE VIEW governed_marketing_analyst.aml_large_cash_txn AS SELECT transaction_key, customer_key, md5(full_name::text) AS full_name, md5(date_of_birth::text) AS date_of_birth, occupation, amount_cad, txn_date, branch_transit FROM mart.aml_large_cash_txn
GRANT SELECT ON governed_marketing_analyst.aml_large_cash_txn TO marketing_analyst
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS governed_marketing_analyst.marketing_campaign_audience

CREATE VIEW governed_marketing_analyst.marketing_campaign_audience AS SELECT customer_key, full_name, email, segment, consent_marketing, extracted_at FROM mart.marketing_campaign_audience WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dw.dim_consent dc WHERE dc.customer_key = mart.marketing_campaign_audience.customer_key AND dc.purpose = 'MARKETING_EMAIL' AND dc.granted AND dc.withdrawn_on IS NULL)
GRANT SELECT ON governed_marketing_analyst.marketing_campaign_audience TO marketing_analyst
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS governed_marketing_analyst.monthly_branch_activity
CREATE VIEW governed_marketing_analyst.monthly_branch_activity AS SELECT year, month, branch_key, txn_count, total_amount_cad, active_customers FROM mart.monthly_branch_activity
GRANT SELECT ON governed_marketing_analyst.monthly_branch_activity TO marketing_analyst
